verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a cloud file-conversion service, but the evidence shows only a drag-and-drop web UI, a REST API, a CLI and code wrappers. None of these accepts natural-language commands, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. A conventional CLI or API is not natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
